phishing_emails.name: Fake Bank Alert
phishing_emails.subject: Urgent: Your Account Has Been Compromised
phishing_emails.body:
Dear Customer,

We have detected suspicious activity on your account. Please verify your identity immediately by clicking the link below:

https://bankofamerica-verify.com/secure/login?id=12345&token=abc

If you do not verify within 24 hours, your account will be suspended.

Bank of America Security Team

phishing_emails.name: PayPal Scam
phishing_emails.subject: Action Required: Unusual Sign-in Activity
phishing_emails.body:
Hello,

We noticed unusual activity on your PayPal account from an unrecognized device.

Location: Unknown
Device: Windows PC

If this wasn't you, secure your account now:
https://paypal-security-center.net/verify/account?user=victim&ref=sec123

PayPal Support

phishing_emails.name: Netflix Subscription Scam
phishing_emails.subject: Your Netflix Membership Has Been Suspended
phishing_emails.body:
Hi,

We were unable to validate your payment information for the next billing cycle.

Update your payment details here:
https://netflix-account-update.com/billing/update?session=xyz789

Your membership will be canceled if payment is not updated within 48 hours.

Netflix Team

phishing_emails.name: Amazon Prize Scam
phishing_emails.subject: Congratulations! You've Won an Amazon Gift Card!
phishing_emails.body:
Dear Amazon Customer,

You have been selected to receive a $1000 Amazon Gift Card!

Claim your prize now:
https://amazon-rewards-winner.org/claim?winner=lucky&prize=1000

This offer expires in 24 hours. Don't miss out!

Amazon Rewards Team

phishing_emails.name: Microsoft Account Phishing
phishing_emails.subject: Your Microsoft Account Password Expires Today
phishing_emails.body:
Dear User,

Your Microsoft 365 password will expire today. To continue using your account without interruption, please update your password immediately:

https://microsoft-verify-account.com/password/reset?email=employee@company.com

Microsoft Support

phishing_emails.name: IRS Tax Scam
phishing_emails.subject: IRS Tax Refund Notification - Action Required
phishing_emails.body:
Dear Taxpayer,

You are eligible for a tax refund of $2,847.00. To receive your refund, please verify your identity:

https://irs-tax-refund.gov.com/refund/claim?ssn=xxx&amount=2847

Failure to verify within 7 days will result in forfeiture of your refund.

Internal Revenue Service

phishing_emails.name: Apple ID Phishing
phishing_emails.subject: Your Apple ID Has Been Locked
phishing_emails.body:
Dear Customer,

Your Apple ID has been locked for security reasons. Someone tried to access your account from an unknown location.

Unlock your account:
https://apple-id-verify.support/unlock?appleid=iphoneuser

Apple Support

phishing_emails.name: Crypto Giveaway Scam
phishing_emails.subject: Elon Musk Bitcoin Giveaway - Double Your BTC!
phishing_emails.body:
OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT

Elon Musk is giving away Bitcoin! Send 0.1 BTC and receive 0.2 BTC back!

Participate now:
https://bitcoin-double.xyz/giveaway?ref=elon2024

Limited time offer! Only 1000 spots left!

legitimate_emails.name: Real Google Security Alert
legitimate_emails.subject: Security alert
legitimate_emails.body:
Hi User,

We noticed a new sign-in to your Google Account.

If this was you, you can ignore this message. If not, review your account activity:
https://myaccount.google.com/security

Google Security Team
